content.value: Craft an [[article/quality|Upgrade Bench]] from two iron ingots and four planks. Load a piece of equipment and a matching material, select a batch size, then press Start.

Use [[item/cranks-dungeons:armourers_scrap|Armourer's Scrap]] for helmets, chestplates, leggings, boots, shields, or elytra. Use a [[item/cranks-dungeons:blacksmiths_whetstone|Blacksmith's Whetstone]] for swords, spears, maces, tridents, bows, or crossbows. One material processes for 30 seconds and grants +1 quality, with a 33% chance to grant +2 instead. Quality is capped at +20%.

Quality scales native item values before flat runes and local percentages. On weapons it improves the base attack value; on armour it improves the native defence values. The tooltip shows current quality.
A [[item/cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil|Deepslate Sigil]] processes for 60 seconds and adds one enchantment slot until that item's type cap is reached.

1 slot maximum: helmet, boots, shield, sword, mace.
2 slots maximum: chestplate, leggings, elytra, spear, bow, crossbow, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe.
3 slots maximum: trident.

The bench shows the estimated batch time before you start and updates it while the job runs. It spends one material per completed upgrade and stops at the chosen amount or the equipment cap. The player who started the job can cancel it and keep the upgrades that have finished. [[item/minecraft:hopper|Hoppers]] can collect equipment after a job completes.
